_comment: Simulated output of the customer-side code discovery pass: routes, handlers,
state machines, and dependency manifests. Runs on the customer's machine,
which is why it can read the repo at all.
Note what is and isn't here. Structural roles (name, correlation key, steps)
are inferred with evidence. Semantic roles (outcome, failure reason,
magnitude, segment) are absent by design — nothing in a codebase says which
flow generates revenue or what counts as success.

journeys.name: Checkout Flow
journeys.notes: stripe@^18 in package.json — strongest business-criticality signal available from static analysis.
